usedFor: mite tracks time, and “Create project”, “Create Customer” and “Create Service” set up what time is booked to.

bestTemplate.name: “Create project” in mite
bestTemplate.why: A project is what time entries are booked against, so create it along with the work.

watchOut: “Delete Customer”, “Delete Service” and “Delete Project” remove records, so keep them out of unchecked automations.
